def subsets(nums):
    out = []
    def bt(i, path):
        if i == len(nums):
            out.append(path)
            return
        bt(i + 1, path[:])
        path.append(nums[i])
        bt(i + 1, path[:])
    bt(0, [])
    return out

def max_subarray(nums):
    best = float('-inf')
    cur = float('-inf')
    for x in nums:
        cur = max(x, cur + x)
        best = max(best, cur)
    return best
